canonical_project: Thomas-Krenn Freyung data center / show data center and in-house infrastructure
notes: Thomas-Krenn official 2012 announcement: Freyung building expansion emphasized in-house data center and showroom ('Show-Rechenzentrum'); DataCenter-Insider reported 2026 opening of a further Freyung production-site expansion; storage-insider lists HQ at Speltenbach-Steinäcker 1, 94078 Freyung. 2021 Yorizon JV (Thomas-Krenn + HOCHTIEF PPP Solutions) targets sustainable regional DCs, but its pilot is in Heiligenhaus (NRW), not Freyung. MW not disclosed.
